kicker: MiniMax H3, from its model card

scenes.headline: How MiniMax H3 turns any input into video
scenes.sub: Text, image, video or audio in; 2K video with stereo sound out.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Wren! MiniMax H3 takes text, pictures, video or sound, and makes video with its own stereo audio. Here's how it's built.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: One 33B dense transformer serves every modality. Attention and feed-forward blocks are shared; only the edges and some AdaLN branches are modality-specific.
scenes.say: The idea: one dense transformer serves every modality. Attention and feed-forward are shared; only the edges, and some normalization branches, are modality-specific.

steps.say: First, an encoder reads the instruction. It's the full pretrained Qwen3-VL-32B, sampled at its fiftieth layer.
Those features feed a thirty-three billion parameter dense Omni-Transformer, which writes the picture and the sound.
Every modality goes through the same attention and feed-forward blocks. There is no separate tower for sound.
Only the input and output layers, plus a set of normalization branches, are modality-specific: about thirteen billion of the thirty-three.

scenes.title: Three modules, one of them open

steps.say: The full system is three modules. Context-IR turns raw instructions into a structured context, a stage the card calls critical to quality.
H3-Base, the transformer we just saw, generates the video at seven sixty-eight p.
Then Regenerate-2K upsamples it to 2K, guided by the same context.
Only the middle box ships as open weights. The first and last are calls to MiniMax's API.

left.title: Apache-2.0 or MIT
left.say: Most open-weight models ship under Apache or MIT, with no map in the license.

right.title: H3 Community License
items: Excludes the EU, UK, Korea and US
Written authorization above $20 million a year
No benchmark numbers to weigh it against
right.say: H3's license excludes the European Union, the United Kingdom, Korea and the United States, and gates big revenue. And the release has no benchmark numbers at all.

scenes.text: The architecture is disclosed in detail. The openness is partial: one module of three, under a license with borders.
scenes.say: So the architecture is disclosed in detail. The openness is partial: one module of three, under a license with borders.

recap: A Qwen3-VL-32B encoder feeds a 33B transformer
Only H3-Base ships as open weights
scenes.say: To recap: a Qwen encoder, one shared transformer for every modality, and one open module of three.
